summary: A scaffolded collection logs 'collection company_namespace.myapp_network created at <path>' and contains .devcontainer, .github, .vscode, pre-commit and isort configs, changelogs, docs, extensions, galaxy.yml, meta, plugins, roles, tests, pyproject.toml, requirements files and tox-ansible.ini.
